WITH rm AS (SELECT RM_ID, RM_NM FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER WHERE TEAM = 'C&I East'),
prod AS (
  SELECT f.ORIG_RM_ID RM_ID, COUNT(*) n_new, SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) new_commit
  FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f
  WHERE f.ORIG_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY 1),
book AS (
  SELECT c.RM_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FACILITY_ID) n_fac, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) drawn,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.DPD >= 30 THEN b.DRAWN_AMT ELSE 0 END) dpd30
  FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c
  JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.CIF_NO = c.CIF_NO AND f.FACILITY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
  JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID = f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT = '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rm.RM_ID, rm.RM_NM, COALESCE(p.n_new,0) n_new, COALESCE(p.new_commit,0) new_commit,
       bk.n_fac, bk.drawn, bk.dpd30, bk.dpd30/NULLIF(bk.drawn,0) dpd30_rate
FROM rm LEFT JOIN prod p ON p.RM_ID = rm.RM_ID LEFT JOIN book bk ON bk.RM_ID = rm.RM_ID
ORDER BY new_commit DESC

text:
I can't show production against goals. RM goals live in `CORE.RM_GOAL`, and policy POL-IC-03 (from the Commercial Banking Incentive Plan FY2026) lets only the RM_MANAGER and COMP_ANALYST roles see them. As a CREDIT_ANALYST you can see new commitments booked by each RM without the goal, so the table below uses that. To add attainment against goal, someone with an RM_MANAGER or COMP_ANALYST role, or Finance, would need to supply the 2026Q3 goals.

**C&I East: Q3 2026 new-commitment production and 30+ DPD rate of each RM's book (as of 2026-09-30)**

| RM | New facilities (Q3) | New commitments (Q3) | Active facilities in book | Drawn balance | Drawn 30+ DPD | 30+ DPD rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RM002 Marlow Calder | 4 | $89.8M | 18 | $120.8M | $0 | 0.00% |
| RM005 Jordan Thorne | 4 | $85.7M | 22 | $144.9M | $0 | 0.00% |
| RM001 Sage Garrow | 4 | $75.9M | 29 | $253.6M | $2.30M | 0.91% |
| RM006 Gray Lowry | 4 | $68.6M | 21 | $126.4M | $0 | 0.00% |
| RM003 Harper Garrow | 3 | $56.8M | 17 | $108.2M | $4.66M | **4.30%** |
| RM004 Sawyer Rourke | 2 | $29.8M | 24 | $151.9M | $0 | 0.00% |
| **C&I East total** | **21** | **$406.6M** | **131** | **$905.8M** | **$6.95M** | **0.77%** |

**What stands out:**
- Two of the six RMs hold all of the team's 30+ DPD balance.
- Harper Garrow has the weakest book, with a 30+ DPD rate of 4.30%. Production was mid-pack at $56.8M.
- Sage Garrow has the largest book ($254M drawn) and a modest 0.91% delinquency rate.
- Marlow Calder and Jordan Thorne booked the most new commitments ($89.8M and $85.7M) and have no delinquency.
- Sawyer Rourke booked the least ($29.8M) and has a clean book.

**Sources and definitions:**
- **Production:** the ratified `new_commit_attainment` metric without the goal. It adds up the committed amount of facilities in `BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY` that were booked between 2026-07-01 and 2026-09-30 and credited to the RM who originated them. Facilities booked in the quarter are counted whatever their current status.
- **30+ DPD rate:** the ratified `dpd30_rate` metric (Credit Risk; used in the Credit Risk Report). It is the drawn balance 30 or more days past due divided by total drawn balance. It covers active facilities only, so charged-off facilities are excluded, at the 2026-09-30 snapshot (`LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY` joined to `LENDING.FACILITY`).
- **Team:** the six RMs listed as C&I East (East region, Large Corporate segment) in `CORE.RM_ROSTER`.
- **Policy:** POL-IC-03 blocks `CORE.RM_GOAL` for this role.

**Assumptions:**
- "This quarter" is Q3 2026 (July 1 to September 30), treating the fiscal quarter as the calendar quarter.
- An RM's "book" is the active facilities of clients where they are the primary RM. Production, by contrast, is credited to the RM who originated the facility, so the two can cover different facilities.

                  CALL (nm) {
                    MATCH (n) WHERE (n:Concept OR n:DataProduct OR n:Metric OR n:JoinPath OR n:Policy OR n:Report OR n:BusinessRule)

  FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c
  JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.CIF_NO = c.CIF_NO AND f.FACILITY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
  JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID = f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT = '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rm.RM_ID, rm.RM_NM, COALESCE(p.n_new,0) n_new, COALESCE(p.new_commit,0) new_commit,
       bk.n_fac, bk.drawn, bk.dpd30, bk.dpd30/NULLIF(bk.drawn,0) dpd30_rate
FROM rm LEFT JOIN prod p ON p.RM_ID = rm.RM_ID LEFT JOIN book bk ON bk.RM_ID = rm.RM_ID
ORDER BY new_commit DESC
